hunks.baseline: The middle-aged man was an ordinary neighborhood uncle, the kind you could see anywhere.

hunks.sol: A bluish shadow of stubble ran from his sideburns to his chin. His practical hiking clothes bulged around his belly.

hunks.sol: At the crack of dawn, he finished stretching with sleep still heavy in his eyes, then began jogging slowly along a path between the rice paddies.

hunks.baseline: “One-two, one-two,” he went, adding the hearty rhythmic sounds unique to middle-aged uncles.

hunks.baseline: “Is this the man?”

hunks.baseline: “He looks ordinary.”

hunks.baseline: “Even so, that uncle looks too ordinary. Is there something only combat Hunters can recognize?”
hunks.sol: “Still, that man looks way too normal. Is there something only combat Hunters can recognize?”

hunks.baseline: Song Song wasn’t the only one to react to my mutter.

hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi and Butler Kim looked at me as if to ask what I meant, so I continued.

hunks.sol: At times like this, the only answer was absolute denial. If I said I hadn’t said it, what could they do?

hunks.baseline: Their doubtful looks lasted only a moment before Team Leader Choi and Butler Kim nodded as though they agreed with my assessment.
hunks.sol: Their doubtful looks lasted only a moment before Team Leader Choi and Butler Kim nodded in agreement with my assessment.

hunks.baseline: “I agree that he is an A-rank Hunter.”
hunks.sol: “I also believe he is an A-rank Hunter.”

hunks.baseline: “From what I observed, he is a fairly high-level expert even among A-rank Hunters. I had no choice but to keep my distance because I thought he might detect the surveillance magic.”
hunks.sol: “From what I observed, he ranks fairly high even among A-rank Hunters. I had no choice but to keep my distance because I thought he might detect the surveillance magic.”

hunks.baseline: I could understand Butler Kim’s assessment. He was a battle-hardened veteran of the Great Cataclysm and had watched the man himself.
hunks.sol: Butler Kim’s assessment made sense. He was a battle-hardened veteran of the Great Cataclysm and had observed the man in person.

hunks.baseline: But Team Leader Choi’s insight was far sharper than I’d expected.
hunks.sol: But Team Leader Choi had a far keener eye than I’d expected.

hunks.baseline: I asked about the thing I was most curious about.
hunks.sol: I asked what I was most curious about.

hunks.baseline: “We went and retrieved it again.”
hunks.sol: “We retrieved it.”

hunks.baseline: No, I mean how did you do that?
hunks.sol: No, I meant, how did you manage that?

hunks.baseline: Before I could ask, Team Leader Choi pressed his thumb and index finger together, forming a circle.
hunks.sol: Before I could ask, Team Leader Choi pressed his thumb and index finger together to form a circle.

hunks.baseline: “You said this worked on all kinds of things, Taekyung.”
hunks.sol: “You said this works on just about everyone, Taekyung.”

hunks.baseline: “It is an immutable truth. I’ve used the method myself for a long time.”
hunks.sol: “It’s an immutable truth. I’ve made frequent use of it myself for some time.”

hunks.baseline: So he had slipped a bribe to someone on the investigation team.
hunks.sol: So he had bribed someone on the investigation team.

hunks.baseline: “When there is outside pressure, you give them enough money to withstand it.”
hunks.sol: “When there’s outside pressure, you give them enough money to withstand it.”

hunks.baseline: That was impressive.
hunks.sol: Impressive.

hunks.baseline: But from what he said next, even money had its limits.
hunks.sol: But judging by what he said next, even money had its limits.

hunks.baseline: “It appears that someone fairly powerful has gotten involved. Normally, they should have started talking readily enough, but perhaps out of fear, they refused to open their mouths no matter how much money we fed them. The CCTV footage was our best option.”
hunks.sol: “It appears that someone fairly powerful has gotten involved. Normally, they should have told us everything without much resistance, but perhaps they were frightened. No matter how much money we fed them, they refused to talk. The CCTV footage was the best we could get.”

hunks.baseline: “Yes. There were slight discrepancies, possibly because he used an artifact enchanted with Illusion magic, but there is no doubt.”
hunks.sol: “Yes. There were slight discrepancies, possibly because he used an artifact enchanted with Illusion magic, but there’s no doubt it was him.”

hunks.baseline: I had expected something like this to a certain extent, but it seemed the people pulling the strings held considerable power.
hunks.sol: I had expected as much, but it seemed the people pulling the strings wielded considerable power.

hunks.baseline: They had greased the palm of a supreme council member from a political party and manipulated public opinion online as easily as breathing. Even the police and prosecutors—corrupt enough to accept bribes—were afraid to make a move.
hunks.sol: They had greased the palm of a senior official in one of the political parties and manipulated public opinion online at will. Even police officers and prosecutors corrupt enough to accept bribes knew enough to keep their heads down.

hunks.baseline: A major Guild ranked among the top twenty could do this. They were no different from corporate giants standing tall under the name of a Guild.
hunks.sol: A major Guild ranked among the top twenty could pull this off. They were effectively corporate giants operating under the name of a Guild.

hunks.baseline: They had even cultivated an illegal private army of Black Hunters. They had clearly crossed every line.
hunks.sol: They had even cultivated an illegal private army of Black Hunters. That told me everything I needed to know.

hunks.baseline: “He’s an urbanite who fulfilled his dream of moving to the countryside and farming.”
hunks.sol: “He’s a city dweller who fulfilled his dream of moving to the countryside and becoming a farmer.”

hunks.baseline: Butler Kim added a smooth comment as he handed me a tablet.
hunks.sol: Butler Kim smoothly added one more sentence as he handed me a tablet.

hunks.baseline: He was now in his mid-forties. He had accumulated a considerable fortune through stocks more than a decade ago, but after repeatedly collapsing because of a chronic illness, he had decided to move to the countryside.
hunks.sol: He was now in his mid-forties. He had amassed a considerable fortune in the stock market over a decade ago, but after repeatedly collapsing from a chronic illness, he had decided to move to the countryside.

hunks.baseline: “There are hospital records, too.”
hunks.sol: “We even have the hospital records.”

hunks.baseline: I gave a short laugh as I flipped through the medical records.
hunks.sol: I snorted and flicked through the medical records.

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi nodded as though it were obvious.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi nodded as if that went without saying.

hunks.baseline: Was this guy insane? Why was he betting my wrists?
hunks.sol: Was this lunatic serious? Why was he betting my wrist?

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi casually ignored my incredulous stare and continued.
hunks.sol: Casually ignoring my incredulous stare, Team Leader Choi continued.

hunks.baseline: “In any case, on the surface, he is a perfect ordinary citizen. Apparently, he was sociable from the day he first settled there. He held a village feast once every two weeks, so the villagers stopped treating him like an outsider a long time ago.”
hunks.sol: “In any case, on paper, he’s a perfectly ordinary citizen. Apparently, he was sociable from the day he first settled there. He throws a village feast once every two weeks, so the villagers stopped treating him like an outsider long ago.”

hunks.baseline: “No one is suspicious of him in a remote mountain village?”
hunks.sol: “And no one suspects him in a remote mountain village?”

hunks.baseline: “He’s a rich, good-natured man.”
hunks.sol: “He’s rich, good-natured, and generous.”

hunks.baseline: “It’s the perfect place to hide and do things. For example, train Black Hunters.”
hunks.sol: “It’s the perfect place to hide something. Training Black Hunters, for example.”

hunks.baseline: A picturesque two-story detached house. The house itself looked relatively small compared to the spacious yard.
hunks.sol: A picturesque two-story house. The building itself looked relatively small compared to the spacious yard.

hunks.baseline: The men who attacked Im Kkeokjeong numbered three. There was no reason for them to scatter one by one like the Dragon Balls, so I had to assume they were inside that house.
hunks.sol: There had been three men in the group that attacked Im Kkeokjeong. They had no reason to scatter like the Dragon Balls, so I had to assume they were all inside that house.

hunks.baseline: “You said earlier that he held a village feast once every two weeks.”
hunks.sol: “You said he throws a village feast once every two weeks.”

hunks.baseline: “Yes. He orders large quantities of food from outside every time, but… Ah!”
hunks.sol: “Yes. Each time, he orders a large quantity of food from outside, but… Ah!”

hunks.baseline: The village feasts were probably a cover for procuring food and supplies.
hunks.sol: The village feasts were probably a cover for bringing in food and supplies.

hunks.baseline: *There might be quite a few more of them than I thought.*
hunks.sol: *There might be a lot more of them than I thought.*

hunks.baseline: Did he keep the rest crammed into a basement for training?
hunks.sol: Did he keep the rest crammed into a basement to train?

hunks.baseline: Or were they somewhere in the dense forest surrounding the house?
hunks.sol: Or were they hidden somewhere in the dense forest surrounding the house?

hunks.baseline: It was a personal preference, but I hoped they were all huddled together in the basement.
hunks.sol: Personally, I hoped they were all huddled together in the basement.

hunks.baseline: It would make things easier.
hunks.sol: That would make things easier.

hunks.baseline: “Approaching carelessly could backfire. So let’s call it a day for—”
hunks.sol: “Approaching carelessly could backfire. So for today, we should stop here and—”

hunks.baseline: “Yes. Let’s slowly get started.”
hunks.sol: “Yes. It’s about time we got started.”

hunks.baseline: “The three of you come in twenty minutes. It should be mostly over by then.”
hunks.sol: “The three of you can follow in twenty minutes. It should be almost over by then.”

hunks.baseline: All three of them shot me bewildered looks.
hunks.sol: All three of them stared at me in bewilderment.

hunks.baseline: Butler Kim, the most experienced among them, spoke first.
hunks.sol: Butler Kim, the oldest and most experienced among them, spoke first.

hunks.baseline: “Hunter Jin Taekyung. There is nothing more frightening than an enemy whose capabilities you have not assessed.”
hunks.sol: “Hunter Jin Taekyung. Nothing is more dangerous than an enemy whose capabilities you haven’t assessed.”

hunks.baseline: “I mean that dozens of A-rank Hunters like the one I observed could be waiting for you.”
hunks.sol: “There could be dozens of A-rank Hunters like the man I observed waiting for you.”

hunks.baseline: “It’s fine. If anything, the Three Idiots looked stronger than that guy.”
hunks.sol: “It’s fine. Honestly, the Three Idiots looked stronger than that guy.”

hunks.sol: I directed my killing intent at the two Tosa mastiffs baring their teeth at me from behind the iron bars.

hunks.sol: Unless the dogs had attended a Korean language academy, there was no way they could understand me.

hunks.baseline: Refined through countless battles and encounters with death, killing intent awakened a primitive fear.
hunks.sol: Killing intent, honed through countless battles and brushes with death, awakened a primal fear.

hunks.baseline: Even a person with exceptional nerve could wet themselves from it. Dogs, which were even more sensitive to such things, were no exception.

hunks.sol: Sensing my killing intent, the Tosa mastiffs bared their teeth no longer. They tucked their tails beneath their bellies and flattened themselves against the ground, their anxious eyes trembling as they refused even to look my way.
